description.value: Prado Cafe, now trading as Prado Coffee, is a specialty coffee brand founded by Sammy Piccolo, a four-time Canadian Barista Champion who has represented Canada at the World Barista Championships. Starting as a single shop on Commercial Drive focused on quality espresso and neighbourhood hospitality, the brand has grown to multiple locations across Vancouver and Burnaby. The company roasts its own blends, ranging from approachable everyday espresso to seasonal single-origin offerings.
